summary: This is a documentation file (written in Markdown with YAML frontmatter) that describes a feature called 'Contextual Canvas'. It explains that this feature creates a dynamic visual workspace within an application that automatically gathers relevant information based on what the user is currently working on, reducing the need to juggle multiple documents and windows.

explanations.3: This HTML comment tells a documentation processor (likely a static site generator) to highlight the next line visually in the rendered output.
explanations.4: This YAML key stores partial data — configuration or setup information — that will be used when this document is processed.
explanations.5: Another highlight directive, marking the next line as important for the rendered documentation.
explanations.17: This is a template directive that pulls in (includes) the contents of another file located at `_partials/run.md`, allowing the same instructions to be reused across multiple documentation pages.
